$comment: The skill's link to the private AZM X Design System. `ref` is the release the skill is written against; Since 1.3.0 the built parts and token files ship in the public `installer` package, read from `cdn` (jsDelivr, then unpkg) with no sign-in; scripts/design-system.mjs reads the private repository at that tag only for the fonts and the drift check, with the person's own GitHub sign-in. `known` lists differences the owner has ruled on, so the drift check doesn't report them. `fontsFolder` is the company Google Drive folder with the licensed fonts; it opens with an AZM X account. Rulings: azmx-brand v3.0.0 (27 Oct 2026), see CHANGELOG.md.
